chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Old Trafford, 2008. Manchester United against Barcelona, Champions League semi-final. Ronaldo is tackled... the clearance drops to Paul Scholes. First time... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. No touch to stop it. Eyes on the ball, head still, body over it, and he strikes it with his laces.

chapters.label: Top corner
chapters.text: Twenty-five yards, rising, past Victor Valdés into the top corner! One-nil: United are going to the final.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when a clearance drops to you, don't take a touch. Body over the ball, strike it first time.
